item.title: Night Patrol: New Poster Released For Upcoming Horror Cop Film
item.description: A brand-new poster has been released for January's new horror film, Night Patrol, starring Justin Long and CM Punk.

item.title: VR Supermarket Sim Shop & Stuff Adds New Boss Update
item.description: The VR game Shop & Stuff has a new update out now, as you will now have to deal with The Boss as part of your daily tasks

item.title: James Cameron Says Avatar: Fire And Ash "Can Be The Last One"
item.description: Avatar: Fire and Ash director James Cameron says he has "other stories to tell, and I've got other stories to tell within Avatar."

item.title: Send Help: I Want To Be The Next Survivor TV Spot Released
item.description: In a new TV spot released for Sam Raimi's upcoming film Send Help, we find out why Linda is so weirdly prepared to survive on a deserted island.

item.title: Karl Urban's Character For ARK: Lost Colony Revealed
item.description: ARK: Lost Colony gave everyone a first look at how a new character played by Karl Urban will look in the game, and it's... interesting

item.title: Dracula: Official Trailer And Poster For Luc Besson's New Adaptation
item.description: Vertical Entertainment has released the official trailer for Luc Besson's new adaptation of Dracula, which will be released on February 6, 2026.
